Disc Shaped UFO filmed Navigating Trough Clouds by United States Air Force - 2020  

 #UFOTwitter #UFO #UAP

UAP of unknown origin displayed abrupt movement and intelligent control, with the absence of thermal propulsion signatures.    

The Event: On November 23, 2020, at approximately 11:13 UTC, a U.S. military reconnaissance platform (likely a drone) filmed a large, disc-shaped Unidentified Aerial Phenomenon (UAP) navigating through clouds at these coordinates.  

Location Details: The area is a volatile region near the Afghanistan–Pakistan border.  

The Object: It was described in official documentation as a massive craft (estimated 200–400 meters in diameter) with no visible thermal propulsion or flight control surfaces.  

I don't think I need to add anything more to this story; if you follow me, you surely know my opinion on what these unconventional vehicles are and who uses them.
